controller_design.signs: Fdesk_z below desired load gives negative world Z to reduce the table gap; excess desk load relieves upward. Positive object-Z motion/increasing bottom gap adds downward correction. XY terms oppose measured drift/velocity to reduce dragging of an upright bottle.
controller_design.geometry: Hold release entry desired wrist orientation; retain original native14 opening curve and hand names. Evidence does not justify a specific wrist unhooking rotation or joint-specific numeric opening sweep.
controller_design.limit_rationale: Conservative unvalidated design bounds, not identified gains or guaranteed safe physics: 6mm downward travel covers the observed~2.07mm near-table gap without a centimetre-scale search; 4mm lateral reference limit restrains correction rather than transporting the object; slow0.12mm/0.08mm policy increments and path/force/time caps stop excessive or ineffective correction. Force target1.2weight is a modest load margin above the unchanged .8weight gate, not a lower threshold. Table ceiling3weight exceeds the observed~2.8weight entry-history peak while stopping excessive pressing. Parent must verify actual response and geometry.
controller_design.finger_curve: Original release_origin*(1-smooth(progress/100)), projected through unchanged common-origin .006rad/tick and .65 native bounds. Original progress>=115 completion remains; actual support and no hand contact still required.
